sentence: This project develops a framework that helps learning-enabled cyber-physical systems accommodate changes with existing hardware and increase device lifespan.
This project develops methods that fill the gaps in assembled protein sequences using mass spectrometry, algorithms and deep learning.
This project develops a way to degrade plastics with enzymes and microbes and use the degradation products to generate electricity.
This project develops methods that use computers to decode how light scatters in biological tissue so images can reach deeper.
This project develops an implant for fat tissue that controls how fat stores energy and releases health-promoting molecules.
This project builds parts of a particle detector and uses machine learning for energy calibration at a particle accelerator.
This project builds a mathematical tool that helps energy storage operators plan bids and manage risk in wholesale electricity markets.
This project explores polymers and their range of applications.
This project creates an approach that converts sound-based information into a different wave to produce much higher resolution images.
This project studies low-vision behavior and develops wearables that help visually impaired people navigate urban environments and commute.
This project studies entanglement of light beams and tries to use it for quantum sensing and quantum communication.
This project studies how to make artificial intelligence and cybersecurity trustworthy for intelligent vehicles and transportation systems.
This project studies how gut microbes help banner-tailed kangaroo rats get nutrients and survive when resources are limited.
This project develops mathematical and computational tools for modeling directed group interactions in networks.
This project creates quantum machine learning models that search for drug candidates and check how they bind to target proteins.
This project develops algorithms and software that let scientists analyze simulation data on high performance computing systems step by step.
